title: 第7594章 更改对象第7593章 小九放狠话
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
“天命哥怎么跟那人站在一起了？”
“难不成，是那银妍郡主败了，对方要车轮战继续派人跟天命哥战斗？”
“反正天命哥都这么强了，应该没什么问题吧……再说，有小公主在，应该也不怕别人刷阴招。”
当然，在万曜等人无比困惑的时候，姬玄鉴靠近李天命身边，她并没有被隔绝在外。
所以姬玄鉴也知晓了这件事，她有些惊讶道，“难不成，这姬银妍还真要把自己机会弄丢了，转交给天命哥？”
李天命见状不禁陷入了沉思，他其实心中也很惊讶。
他完全没想到打败姬银妍，还能拥有‘武仙组考核’这样的机会，毕竟他相比之下几乎是没有背景可言。
李天命也想不到选拔规则当中，还有中途换考核对象的可能性。
“武仙组……武仙北冕座长城……这两者，会不会有什么关系？”李天命心声疑惑道。
极光缓缓道，“听起来虽然有相似的地方，但目前银尘寻找的消息里面，还没有能证实两者联系的方面。”
“总之，无论何时，我的首要任务还是修炼，所以需要更好的修炼资源，这点毋庸置疑。”李天命陷入了深思，“此外，找到孵化小十的方法，也跟修炼资源同等重要。”
如今他与姬玄鉴怎么说也算是建立了一定联系，再加上李帝霄手里还没交给李天命的姬紫棂的传讯星塔。
跟乾烽皇族搭上线，或许就能够找到孵化小十的线索。
而李天命想要继续修炼成长，有更好的环境和资源也是最重要的。
所以，这武仙组考核的机会，李天命无疑是需要的。
而这时候，四道神秘人影站在一起，似乎要做最后的决策。
“既然是我提出，我当然是认可此人的，其心性、实力，皆是上佳，我认为很适合加入武仙组。”那高挑人影声音缓缓说道。
然而，名为武雉的那道人影却是摇了摇头道，“我不同意，这样底细不明的人若是通过考核，只会平添麻烦。”
“一正一负。”高挑人影没有再多说，而是淡漠说道。
而这时候，两人的目光同时看向余下的两道神秘人影。

在迷雾之下，他们的身躯样貌都几乎难以看见，无比神秘。
其中，有一个高大而且魁梧的身影转头看向李天命。
其声音沙哑粗糙，缓缓说道：“李天命，这场万宗帝战当中，你可有信心拿下第一？”
李天命看向对方，微微一笑道：“问题不大。”
“你就这么自信？”这魁梧人影顿时有些好奇。
“不管你们要不要让我成为考核对象，这万宗帝战我都势在必得。”李天命目光灼灼道。
这个考核的机会对李天命本就是预料之外的事，所以说出要拿万宗帝战成绩的话，并非他逞英雄，为了拿下这个机会。
而对方似乎也明白了李天命的意思。
“呵呵……有意思。”那魁梧身影忽而一笑，而后缓缓道，“反正这姬银妍已败，也已经没了希望，我看不如就给你一个机会，我叫韩煊，你叫我煊哥就行。”
此话一落，也代表着对方决定站李天命一票，同意其成为考核对象。
“多谢煊哥。”李天命微微一笑，抱拳道。
“二对一。”那提出更改考核对象的高挑人影淡淡说道。
如今李天命距离获得成为考核对象的机会，就只剩一票！
究竟是让李天命通过这决策，成为考核对象，还是从此成为路人，只差最后一人的决定！
content_en:
"Brother Tianming, why are you standing with that person?"
"Is it possible that Princess Yinyan was defeated and the other party wants to continue sending people to fight Brother Tianming?"
"Anyway, Brother Tianming is so strong, so there shouldn't be any problem... Besides, with the little princess here, I shouldn't be afraid of others using dirty tricks."
Of course, when Wan Yao and others were extremely confused, Ji Xuanjian approached Li Tianming, and she was not isolated.
So Ji Xuanjian also knew about this, and she was a little surprised and said, "Is it possible that Ji Yinyan really wants to lose her opportunity and hand it over to Brother Tianming?"
Li Tianming couldn't help but fell into deep thought when he saw this. He was actually very surprised.
He never expected that after defeating Ji Yinyan, he would have an opportunity like the 'Martial Immortal Group Assessment'. After all, he had almost no background in comparison.
Li Tianming also didn't expect that the selection rules would include the possibility of changing the assessment objects midway.
"Wuxian group... Wuxian Beichengao Great Wall... are there any relationship between the two?" Li Tianming wondered in his heart.
Ji Guang said slowly, "Although it sounds similar, there is currently no information that Yin Chen is looking for that can confirm the connection between the two."
"In short, my first priority is cultivation at all times, so I need better cultivation resources. There is no doubt about this." Li Tianming fell into deep thought. "In addition, finding a way to incubate Xiao Shi is equally important as cultivation resources."
Now he has established a certain connection with Ji Xuanjian, and Li Dixiao has not yet handed over Ji Ziling's communication star tower to Li Tianming.
By getting in touch with the Qianfeng royal family, we might be able to find clues to hatching Xiao Shi.
And if Li Tianming wants to continue to practice and grow, having a better environment and resources is also the most important thing.
Therefore, Li Tianming undoubtedly needs this opportunity for the Martial Arts Group's assessment.
At this time, four mysterious figures stood together, seemingly making the final decision.
"Since it was me who proposed it, of course I approve of this person. His character and strength are both excellent. I think he is very suitable to join the Martial Immortal Group." The tall figure said slowly.
However, the figure named Wu Zhi shook his head and said, "I don't agree. If such an unknown person passes the assessment, it will only cause more trouble."
"One positive and one negative." The tall figure said indifferently without saying any more.
At this time, the two of them looked at the remaining two mysterious figures at the same time.
Under the mist, their bodies and appearances were almost invisible and extremely mysterious.
Among them, there was a tall and burly figure who turned to look at Li Tianming.
His voice was hoarse and rough, and he said slowly: "Li Tianming, in this battle between Ten Thousand Sect Emperors, are you confident that you will win the first place?"
Li Tianming looked at the other party, smiled slightly and said, "It's not a big problem."
"Are you so confident?" The burly figure suddenly became curious.
"Whether you want me to be the subject of the assessment or not, I am bound to win this Ten Thousand Sects Emperor Battle." Li Tianming said with blazing eyes.
This assessment opportunity was unexpected for Li Tianming, so when he said he wanted to get the Wan Zong Emperor results, he was not trying to be a hero just to win this opportunity.
And the other party seemed to understand what Li Tianming meant.
"Haha... interesting." The burly figure suddenly smiled, and then slowly said, "Anyway, Ji Yinyan has been defeated and has no hope. I think it's better to give you a chance. My name is Han Xuan. You can just call me Brother Xuan."
Once these words were spoken, it also meant that the other party decided to support Li Tianming and agreed that he would become the subject of the assessment.
"Thank you, Brother Xuan." Li Tianming smiled slightly and cupped his fists.
"Two versus one." The tall figure who proposed changing the assessment object said calmly.
Now Li Tianming is only one vote away from getting the chance to become the subject of the assessment!
Should Li Tianming pass this decision and become the subject of assessment, or should he become a passerby from now on?, only the last person’s decision is left!
